items.title: Mike Wofford interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: she had called Roy first and I think Roy then had recommended me and Andy Simpkins was the bass player. And so that was the trio for the first year

ctx.x: Sarah Vaughan for one. How did that come about?

I’m never really sure. I was with her two years, two separate years. I worked with her 12 months in ‘79 and then left and went back in ‘83 and worked another full year. But I think I probably initially got the job through Roy McCurdy who was a good friend of mine and we had played together a lot when he came off the road after he’d been with Cannon for so long, he settled in L.A. And Sarah had called him I think as I remember, she was putting together a new back-up trio and she had called Roy first and I think…
her, and at that point it was still Andy and Harold Jones still. So we had a good time. And Sarah was just fantastic.
